name: Kingswell Duck Confit Pastilla in Spiced Phyllo Pastry (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Shredded duck in cinnamon-dusted phyllo is tender, but rendered duck fat, dried fruit, and almonds in traditional pastilla can trigger flares.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Save for remission and choose the Hyperion Four-Cheese Tri-Color Tortelloni or Burrata starter on sensitive days.
watchOuts: Possible sliced almonds and dried fruit inside pastilla
